fusions.name: Dart Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darts dipped in your skin's poison in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 6 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Long Release
fusions.desc: Draws your tongue back and looses it at one enemy up to 9 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Self-Loosed
fusions.desc: Looses you 5 tiles forward off both legs. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: At Full Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
